answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks using Proof of Burn. To participate, each node must irrevocably destroy native cryptocurrency to register its public key and mint a jade credential. This shatters the fable of costless agent creation by imposing an unrecoverable capital expenditure per identity, ensuring forged queries cannot echo unchecked across peer relays. However, this financial barrier favors well-funded cartels while penalizing resource-constrained, legitimate newcomers.
